messages:
yara: Following up on the postmortem items 1 we're still seeing a low-rate but recurring mismatch between regional aggregates and global rollups. Seems tied to replication lag + an unexpected compaction cron. Opening owner sync. cc @dmitri @sylvia
dmitri: Can you share the mismatch check you used?
yara: Quick check:```
-- per-region vs global aggregate mismatch
SELECT region, date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, sum(val) as regional_sum
FROM telemetry.aggregates_region
WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY region, hr
ORDER BY hr DESC;
-- compare to global: SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, sum(val) as global_sum FROM telemetry.aggregates_global WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr DESC;
```
sylvia: I plotted both and see a repeating pattern: regional_sum dips at 02:10 and 14:10 UTC, global_sum is steady. Dips correlate with replication backlog in region eu-west-2.
ops-bot: Alert: "regional-rollup-drift" triggered. Incident INC-20804 created. Playbook: /playbooks/replication-rollup.md
dmitri: Logs show a compaction cron running at 02:05 UTC that aggressively compacts lagging shards and purges partially-applied segments. Snippet:```
[2026-11-05T02:05:03Z] compactor: info: starting scheduled compaction group=shard-42
[2026-11-05T02:05:09Z] compactor: warn: purging orphaned-segment id=seg-998 reason=partial-apply
```
yara: That explains losing partial spans that hadn't replicated yet. Who owns compaction schedule?
sylvia: Compaction is owned by infra-scheduling. We moved to daily aggressive compaction in Aug to save storage. Might have regressed replication safety.
dmitri: Proposed mitigations: short-term: pause compaction in eu-west-2 during peak replication windows, add a TTL guard of 24h before purging partially-applied segments. mid-term: add replication-aware compaction that checks in-flight replication offsets. Owners and timelines: infra -> pause + schedule change (12h), dmitri -> compactor TTL guard + tests (48h), yara -> postmortem addendum + customer impact calc (72h), product-analytics -> quantify affected SLOs and customers (72h).
product-analytics: I'll run a query to map impacted customers once you have canary logs; ETA 48-72h.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20804 updated: owners set [infra, dmitri, yara]; priority P2. Next review scheduled in 24h.
yara: Quick short-term action list I'm adding to the tracker INC-20804:
1) infra: pause compaction in eu-west-2 for next 48h and add schedule change (due +12h)
2) dmitri: implement 24h TTL guard before purge + add replication-offset check to compactor (due +48h)
3) yara: postmortem addendum + SLO delta calc + recurring watch rule (due +72h)
4) product-analytics: impact mapping + stakeholder template (due +72h)
Please react with :white_check_mark: when you start items.
dmitri: :white_check_mark: started work on TTL guard, opening WIP PR https://git.internal/compactor/pull/1012
infra: :white_check_mark: paused compaction for eu-west-2 and updated schedule ticket INF-20804. Canary to resume with replication-aware mode planned.
ops-bot: Monitor updated: "replication-lag" threshold lowered for eu-west-2 to catch early backlog growth. Will page on exceedance.
sylvia: Also note: replication lag stems from a recent network egress policy that deprioritized cross-region traffic during maintenance windows. Recommend infra revert that policy or provision dedicated replication lanes. Can infra own this follow-up?
infra: Filing INF-20805 to review network egress policy; will propose revert or dedicated routes (due +48h).
yara: OK adding INF-20805 to tracker as dependency. We should also add an audit entry for the compaction policy change that introduced the risk (Aug). I'll include config diff in the postmortem.
dmitri: Implementation note: compactor will now check replication_high_watermark(region, shard) and skip purge if last_replicated_offset < purge_cutoff; pseudo:```
if now - segment_age < 24h or last_replicated_offset < segment_end_offset: skip_purge()
else: purge_segment()
```
product-analytics: When you have canary results, I'll compute affected trace coverage and SLO impact and prepare a short note for customers.
yara: Action recap in INC-20804: pause compaction (infra, 12h), compactor TTL + offsets (dmitri, 48h), network egress review (infra, 48h), postmortem addendum + recurrence monitor (yara, 72h), customer impact (product-analytics, 72h).
sylvia: I'll add a short-term monitoring rule that alerts when compactor purges > 0 partial segments in any region in 24h.
ops-bot: New monitor created: "compactor-partial-purge". Will page on first purge event.
yara: Thanks everyone. I'll attach this thread and the canary links to the postmortem. Closing triage for now; owners update INC-20804 as you progress.
